title.zh: 核對現金記錄

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by a Hong Kong retail business. Not endorsed by any real company. You are the accounting assistant at a fictional trading company. The month-end close is due and the cash book closing balance does not agree with the bank statement closing balance. Using the supplied fictional policy, cash book extract, bank statement extract and working CSV, prepare the reconciliation, identify the two timing items, and write a short handover. All records are synthetic.
brief.zh: 本練習為受香港零售業務啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非任何真實公司認可。你是虛構貿易公司的會計助理。月結將至，現金賬簿結餘與銀行結單結餘不符。請根據提供的虛構政策、現金賬簿摘錄、銀行結單摘錄及工作 CSV，編製對賬表，指出兩項時間性項目，並撰寫簡短交接。所有記錄均為虛構。

title.zh: 月結現金對賬政策（虛構）

body.en: This fictional policy applies to the month-end close. All balances are stated as positive amounts in HKD. Use explicit addition and subtraction only. Never use debit or credit notation. The cash book closing balance is the recorded balance before any correction. The bank statement closing balance is the balance printed by the bank. Timing items are amounts already recorded in one record but not yet in the other. A deposit in transit is money recorded in the cash book but not yet shown on the statement, so add it to the statement balance. An uncleared payment is money recorded in the cash book but not yet deducted by the bank, so subtract it from the statement balance. The reconciliation is complete only when the adjusted statement balance equals the cash book closing balance exactly. The review owner for this reconciliation is the accounting team lead, Wong Ka-yan.
body.zh: 本虛構政策適用於月結。所有結餘均以港元正數列示。只可使用明確的加減法，不得使用借貸記賬法。現金賬簿結餘為任何更正前的記錄結餘。銀行結單結餘為銀行列印的結餘。時間性項目指已記入其中一份記錄但尚未記入另一份的金額。在途存款是已記入現金賬簿但結單尚未顯示的款項，因此加至結單結餘。未過賬付款是已記入現金賬簿但銀行尚未扣減的款項，因此從結單結餘中減去。只有當調整後結單結餘與現金賬簿結餘完全相等時，對賬才算完成。本對賬的覆核負責人為會計團隊主管 Wong Ka-yan。

title.zh: 三月三十一日現金賬簿摘錄（虛構）

body.en: All amounts are positive HKD. The cash book closing balance at 31 March is 184,600.00. The cutoff is 31 March. Two entries are recorded in the cash book but not yet reflected on the bank statement. Entry CB-07 is a deposit in transit of 12,400.00 received from a customer on 30 March. Entry CB-12 is an uncleared payment of 7,900.00 issued as a supplier cheque on 29 March. No other timing items exist. This extract is not a complete transaction ledger. It shows only the closing balance and the two timing items.
body.zh: 所有金額均為港元正數。三月三十一日現金賬簿結餘為 184,600.00。截止日為三月三十一日。有兩筆分錄已記入現金賬簿但銀行結單尚未反映。分錄 CB-07 為三月三十日收到客戶的在途存款 12,400.00。分錄 CB-12 為三月二十九日開出供應商支票的未過賬付款 7,900.00。並無其他時間性項目。本摘錄並非完整交易賬簿，僅列示結餘及兩項時間性項目。

title.zh: 三月三十一日銀行結單摘錄（虛構）

body.en: All amounts are positive HKD. The bank statement closing balance at 31 March is 180,100.00. The statement cutoff is 31 March. The statement does not yet show the 30 March deposit of 12,400.00 and does not yet show the 29 March supplier cheque of 7,900.00. No bank fees, interest or other adjustments appear on this statement. This extract is not a complete transaction ledger. It shows only the closing balance and the two items not yet reflected.

title.zh: 月結現金對賬政策（虛構）

body.en: This fictional policy applies to the 31 May close. All balances are stated as positive amounts in HKD. Use explicit addition and subtraction only. Never use debit or credit notation. The cash book closing balance is the recorded balance before any correction. The bank statement closing balance is the balance printed by the bank. A duplicated cash book payment is a payment recorded twice in the cash book but only once by the bank, so add the duplicated amount back to the recorded cash book balance. A bank fee omitted from the cash book is a charge shown on the statement but not yet recorded in the cash book, so subtract the fee from the recorded cash book balance. The corrected cash book balance must equal the bank statement closing balance exactly. There are no outstanding items in this case. The review owner for this reconciliation is the accounting team lead, Chan Mei-ling.
body.zh: 本虛構政策適用於五月三十一日月結。所有結餘均以港元正數列示。只可使用明確的加減法，不得使用借貸記賬法。現金賬簿結餘為任何更正前的記錄結餘。銀行結單結餘為銀行列印的結餘。重複記賬的現金賬簿付款是現金賬簿記錄兩次但銀行只記錄一次的付款，因此把重複金額加回記錄的現金賬簿結餘。現金賬簿遺漏的銀行費用是結單顯示但現金賬簿尚未記錄的收費，因此從記錄的現金賬簿結餘中減去該費用。更正後現金賬簿結餘必須與銀行結單結餘完全相等。本個案並無未清項目。本對賬的覆核負責人為會計團隊主管 Chan Mei-ling。

title.zh: 發票配對及授權規則（虛構）

body.en: Fictional internal rules for this simulation only. Quantity rule: an invoice line is released only when the invoiced quantity is less than or equal to the received quantity and the received quantity is less than or equal to the ordered quantity. Any other combination is held. Price rule: a line is released only when the unit price on the invoice is less than or equal to the unit price on the purchase order. Any excess is held. Approval rule: an invoice is released only when its total is less than or equal to the approver limit of the named approver and the approval reference is present. If the total exceeds the approver limit, the invoice is held. If the approval reference is missing, the invoice is held. An invoice is released only when every line passes the quantity and price rules and the approval rule passes. Otherwise the whole invoice is held. Mandatory review owner for all held items: K. Lau, accounts payable team lead.
body.zh: 本模擬專用的虛構內部規則。數量規則：只有當發票數量小於或等於收貨數量，且收貨數量小於或等於訂購數量時，該發票行才可放行。其他組合一律暫停。價格規則：只有當發票單價小於或等於採購訂單單價時，該行才可放行。超出部分一律暫停。授權規則：只有當發票總額小於或等於指定審批人的審批限額，且審批參考編號齊備時，該發票才可放行。總額超出審批限額，發票暫停。審批參考編號缺失，發票暫停。只有當所有行均通過數量及價格規則，且授權規則通過時，整張發票才可放行。否則整張發票暫停。所有暫停項目的強制審查負責人：應付帳款團隊主管 K. Lau。

title.en: Invoice documentary hold and release rules (fictional)
title.zh: 發票文件暫停及放行規則（虛構）

body.en: Fictional internal rules for this simulation only. Duplicate rule: an invoice is held when its invoice reference already appears on an earlier invoice in the same batch. The earlier invoice is the original and is not held for this reason. The later invoice is the duplicate and is held. Missing approval rule: an invoice is held when its approval reference is blank. An invoice is released only when it is not a duplicate and its approval reference is present. Otherwise the whole invoice is held. A missing approval reference is a documentary gap only and is not evidence of suspected wrongdoing. Mandatory review owner for all held items: K. Lau, accounts payable team lead.
body.zh: 本模擬專用的虛構內部規則。重複規則：若某發票的發票參考編號已出現在同批次較早的發票上，該發票暫停。較早的發票為正本，不因此規則暫停。較後的發票為重複，須暫停。缺失審批規則：若發票的審批參考編號為空白，該發票暫停。只有當發票並非重複且審批參考編號齊備時，該發票才可放行。否則整張發票暫停。缺失審批參考編號僅屬文件缺口，並非懷疑不當行為的證據。所有暫停項目的強制審查負責人：應付帳款團隊主管 K. Lau。

body.en: Fictional planning rules for Hawkstone Precision, a simulated manufacturer. The planning week contains five weekday shifts from Monday to Friday. Each shift is 8.00 hours gross. Customer demand for the week is 3,000 units of bracket BR-220. Overtime is allowed up to 2.00 hours per shift per week at HKD 180 per hour. A separate added shift uses the same 0.75 hour planned downtime and costs HKD 260 per hour gross. Rank feasible responses by lowest incremental cost per unit produced, then by earliest completion. A response is feasible only when its output is at least the shortfall and every limit is respected.

title.zh: 良率定義及檢視規則（合成）

body.en: Fictional rules for this simulation. (1) Denominator is units_started for the three reporting lots, in whole units. (2) First-pass accepted units equal units_started minus units_rejected_first_pass. (3) First-pass yield is first-pass accepted units divided by units_started, reported as a percentage to two decimal places. (4) A rework record counts toward recoverable units only when origination_lot is one of the three reporting lots. Rework counted for a lot may not exceed that lot units_rejected_first_pass. (5) Integrity check: units_reworked equals units_passed_rework plus units_failed_rework. (6) Final accepted units equal first-pass accepted units plus in-period units_passed_rework. (7) Final accepted yield is final accepted units divided by units_started, to two decimal places. (8) A lot with first-pass yield below 96.00 per cent needs a yield review. The period result escalates to the production quality lead when the combined first-pass yield is below 96.50 per cent. (9) Do not infer a root cause from these records.
body.zh: 本模擬的虛構規則。(1) 分母為三個報告批次的 units_started，以整數單位計。(2) 首次通過單位等於 units_started 減 units_rejected_first_pass。(3) 首次通過良率等於首次通過單位除以 units_started，以百分比表示並取兩位小數。(4) 返工記錄只有在 origination_lot 為三個報告批次之一時，才計入可回收單位。某批次計入的返工數不得多於該批次的 units_rejected_first_pass。(5) 完整性檢查：units_reworked 等於 units_passed_rework 加 units_failed_rework。(6) 最終接受單位等於首次通過單位加期內 units_passed_rework。(7) 最終接受良率等於最終接受單位除以 units_started，取兩位小數。(8) 首次通過良率低於 96.00% 的批次需要良率檢視。當合併首次通過良率低於 96.50% 時，本期結果上報至生產品質主管。(9) 不得從這些記錄推斷根本原因。

title.zh: 資格及最終良率規則（合成）

body.en: Fictional rules for this simulation. (1) A row is eligible only when run_type is production. Rows with run_type trial are excluded from every calculation. (2) Among eligible rows, keep only the first occurrence of each batch_id in record_id order and exclude any later duplicate of that batch_id. (3) Eligible units started are the sum of units_started over the kept rows, in whole units. (4) Final accepted units are the sum of accepted_units over the kept rows, in whole units. (5) Aggregate final accepted yield is final accepted units divided by eligible units started, reported as a percentage to two decimal places. (6) When the aggregate final accepted yield is below 97.50 per cent, route the affected batch to quality engineering and escalate the period result to the production quality lead. Otherwise no follow-up is required. (7) Do not infer a root cause from these records.
body.zh: 本模擬的虛構規則。(1) 只有 run_type 為 production 的記錄才合資格。run_type 為 trial 的記錄從所有計算中排除。(2) 在合資格記錄中，按 record_id 次序只保留每個 batch_id 的首次出現，並排除該 batch_id 其後的重複記錄。(3) 合資格開工單位為保留記錄的 units_started 總和，以整數單位計。(4) 最終接受單位為保留記錄的 accepted_units 總和，以整數單位計。(5) 合併最終接受良率等於最終接受單位除以合資格開工單位，以百分比表示並取兩位小數。(6) 當合併最終接受良率低於 97.50% 時，把受影響批次交由品質工程檢視，並把本期結果上報至生產品質主管。否則毋須跟進。(7) 不得從這些記錄推斷根本原因。

body.en:
Fictional learning data for a Hong Kong retail test. All figures are synthetic. Attributed conversions are unique per channel and do not overlap. Spend is the channel cost in HKD. Attributed conversions are counted once per channel. Cost per attributed conversion equals spend divided by attributed conversions. Minimum volume condition: a channel is eligible only if attributed conversions are at least 120. Ranking objective: among eligible channels, rank by lowest cost per attributed conversion. Budget: HKD 60,000 total test budget. Allocation rule: allocate the full budget equally between the two eligible channels with the lowest cost per attributed conversion. If fewer than two channels are eligible, allocate the full budget to the single eligible channel.

```csv
channel_id,channel_name,spend_hkd,attributed_conversions
ch-a,Search ads,24000,160
ch-b,Social video,30000,150
ch-c,Display banner,18000,90
ch-d,Email digest,12000,120
ch-e,Affiliate network,20000,100
```

body.en:
Fictional learning data for a Hong Kong retail test. All figures are synthetic. Attributed conversions are unique per channel and do not overlap. Spend is the channel cost in HKD. Margin per attributed conversion is the fully supplied contribution in HKD earned per attributed conversion. Contribution after channel spend equals attributed conversions multiplied by margin per attributed conversion, minus spend. Minimum volume condition: a channel is eligible only if attributed conversions are at least 100. Ranking objective: among eligible channels, rank by highest contribution after channel spend. Budget: HKD 50,000 total test budget. Allocation rule: allocate the full budget equally between the two eligible channels with the highest contribution after channel spend. If fewer than two channels are eligible, allocate the full budget to the single eligible channel.

body.en: Fictional internal rule. Rank friction codes by mention rate, defined as mentions divided by interviews_probed. The code with the highest mention rate is the priority friction. Only the single priority friction may be taken into the pilot.

body.en: Fictional constraints. Pilot budget is HKD 6,000. Each opted-in participant costs HKD 150. The pilot will recruit exactly the maximum number of participants the budget allows. Recruitment must be opt-in only, with a plain-language consent line and no identifiers retained. Success rule: the pilot succeeds only if at least 60 percent of the recruited participants complete the target task without assistance. The approval owner is the Customer Insights Lead. Any result below 60 percent is treated as not successful and must be escalated.

brief.en: You are a marketing analyst in a fictional Hong Kong online-grocery team. A synthetic opt-in survey has been logged with unequal response groups. Read the survey evidence table, the selection rule and the experiment note, then decide which friction to test, how many participants the budget allows, the minimum completions needed, and the recruitment conditions. title.zh: 虛構自願參與問卷證據表

body.en:
Fictional counts only. Each row is one friction code. Respondents opted in from a fictional panel and consented to aggregated use. No identifiers are stored. Units: respondents is the number of opted-in respondents who answered that code's question. raised is the number of those respondents who raised that friction. Groups are unequal, so compare rates, not raw counts.

```csv
row_id,friction_code,respondents,raised
S-01,basket_editing,120,54
S-02,delivery_slots,80,44
S-03,substitution_rules,60,33
S-04,payment_methods,40,14
S-05,reorder_flow,100,40
S-06,label_clarity,50,20
```

Every respondent answered only the questions for their assigned group. No population claim is made.
body.zh:
僅為虛構數字。每行代表一個痛點代碼。回應者由虛構小組自願參與，並同意作彙總用途。不儲存任何識別資料。單位：respondents 為回答該代碼問題的自願回應者數目。raised 為其中提出該痛點的數目。各組數目不等，因此應比較比率而非原始數目。

```csv
row_id,friction_code,respondents,raised
S-01,basket_editing,120,54
S-02,delivery_slots,80,44
S-03,substitution_rules,60,33
S-04,payment_methods,40,14
S-05,reorder_flow,100,40
S-06,label_clarity,50,20
```

每位回應者只回答其所屬組別的問題。本表不作出任何整體人口聲明。

title.zh: 痛點選取規則（虛構）

body.en: Fictional internal rule. Rank friction codes by raise rate, defined as raised divided by respondents. The code with the highest raise rate is the priority friction. If two codes tie on raise rate, the code with the higher raised count wins. If they still tie, the lower row_id wins. Only the single priority friction may enter the experiment.
body.zh: 虛構內部規則。按提出率把痛點代碼排序，提出率定義為 raised 除以 respondents。提出率最高的代碼為優先痛點。若兩個代碼提出率相同，則以 raised 數目較高者為優先。若仍然相同，則以較小的 row_id 為準。只有單一優先痛點可進入實驗。

title.zh: 實驗預算及成功備註（虛構）

body.en: Fictional constraints. Experiment budget is HKD 4,500. Each opted-in participant costs HKD 90. This experiment plans to recruit exactly the maximum participant count the budget permits. Recruitment must be opt-in only, with a plain-language consent line, and no identifiers retained. Success threshold: the experiment succeeds only if at least 70 percent of participants complete the target task without assistance. The approval owner is the Customer Insights Lead. Any result below 70 percent is not successful and must be escalated.
body.zh: 虛構限制。實驗預算為 4,500 港元。每位自願參加者成本為 90 港元。本實驗計劃招募的人數，正好等於預算可容許的上限。招募必須自願，附有淺白同意聲明，並不保留任何識別資料。成功門檻：只有當至少 70% 參加者能在無協助下完成目標任務，實驗方為成功。審批負責人為客戶洞察主管。任何低於 70% 的結果均視為不成功，必須上報。

exemplar.zh: 證據：虛構自願問卷顯示提出率為 basket_editing 54/120 = 45.0%、delivery_slots 44/80 = 55.0%、substitution_rules 33/60 = 55.0%、payment_methods 14/40 = 35.0%、reorder_flow 40/100 = 40.0%、label_clarity 20/50 = 40.0%。決策：delivery_slots 與 substitution_rules 同為 55.0%，故以 raised 數目較高者為準，delivery_slots（44）為優先痛點。計算：預算 4,500 港元、每位參加者 90 港元，可容許 50 名參加者，而本實驗計劃正好招募此上限。70% 成功門檻需要最少 35 名在無協助下完成。招募必須自願，附淺白同意聲明，並不保留識別資料。風險：各組數目不等，不作出整體人口聲明。下一步：由客戶洞察主管審批，任何低於 70% 的結果須上報。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. You apply the tie-break properly so delivery_slots (44/80 = 55.0 percent) beats substitution_rules (33/60 = 55.0 percent) on the higher raised count, and 4500 / 90 = 50 participants with 70 percent giving 35 completions is right, with the correct consent and no-identifier recruitment set.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。你正確套用決勝規則，delivery_slots（44/80 = 55.0%）以較高 raised 數目勝過 substitution_rules（33/60 = 55.0%），而 4500 / 90 = 50 名參加者及 70% 得出 35 名完成人數亦正確，招募條件亦選對。

feedback.en: You cite every survey row and show each raise rate from the respondents and raised counts, which grounds the priority choice in the supplied table. The tie-break explanation naming 44 against 33 is exactly the reasoning the selection rule requires.
feedback.zh: 你引用了問卷每一列並由 respondents 及 raised 計算出各提出率，令優先痛點的選擇有表內數據支持。你以 44 對 33 解釋決勝規則，正是選取規則要求的推理。

feedback.en: You note the Customer Insights Lead approves and that results below 70 percent are escalated, which covers ownership and the failure path. Add concrete checks before launch, such as recomputing the raise rates, confirming the tie-break was applied as written, and re-verifying the consent line and no-identifier retention.
feedback.zh: 你指出由客戶洞察主管審批，以及低於 70% 的結果須上報，涵蓋負責人及失敗處理路徑。建議在開始前加入具體檢查，例如重新計算各提出率、確認已按規則套用決勝條件，並再次核實同意聲明及不保留識別資料。

feedback.en: You correctly flag that the survey groups are unequal and that no population claim is made, which limits the evidence appropriately. State explicitly that the experiment result is not yet known and that all findings stay within this fictional scenario.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出各組數目不等且不作出整體人口聲明，恰當地限制了證據的適用範圍。可再明確指出實驗結果尚未知，且所有結論只限於此虛構情境。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and decision-first, listing the priority friction, the 50-participant cap, the 35-completion threshold, recruitment conditions, approval owner and escalation trigger. It reads as an actionable briefing for the Customer Insights Lead.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔並以決策為先，列明優先痛點、50 名參加者上限、35 名完成門檻、招募條件、審批負責人及上報條件。整體可作為客戶洞察主管可執行的簡報。

summary.en: All four structured decisions are correct and the written evidence fully justifies them, including the 55.0 percent tie and the 44 versus 33 tie-break, the 50-participant budget cap and the 35-completion success threshold. The main gaps are concrete pre-launch verification checks and an explicit note that the experiment outcome is still unknown.
summary.zh: 四項結構化決策全部正確，書面證據亦充分支持，包括 55.0% 的同分情況及 44 對 33 的決勝依據、50 名參加者的預算上限及 35 名完成人數的成功門檻。主要不足在於具體的開始前核實檢查，以及明確指出實驗結果仍屬未知。
